dedupe_keys.name: horizontal to vertical spectral ratios hvnsr on ambient noise recordings of stations of the 6n network during the activities of the emersito ingv emergency group in ancona italy following the 2022 mw 5 5 costa marchigiana pesarese earthquake

description: Italy’s Istituto Nazionale di Geofisica e Vulcanologia publishes horizontal-to-vertical ambient-noise spectral ratios for eleven Ancona monitoring sites. The temporary 6N network recorded noise and aftershocks from November 2022 through February 2023. Station files list frequency, mean noise ratio and values one standard deviation below and above the mean in comma-separated text columns. Zenodo makes the deposit public and free under CC-BY-4.0. These summaries can identify characteristic site frequencies, but their interpretation depends on the noise field and subsurface structure. A limitation is that they are not direct estimates of damage or full strong-motion amplification. They can support parameter choices and plausibility checks for urban ground-response simulations. The resource complements earthquake-derived ratios and directional noise products from the same deployment. Raw recordings are available through a separately cited 6N archive; no waveform download or spectral calculation was undertaken. Coverage is limited to Ancona.
name: Horizontal to vertical spectral ratios (HVNSR) on ambient noise recordings of stations of the 6N network during the activities of the EMERSITO INGV emergency group in Ancona (Italy) following the 2022 MW 5.5 Costa Marchigiana-Pesarese earthquake
